parsed.rationale: Although both records are `type-alias-object` kinds with `shared_field_count: 2` and neither is test, codegen, mock, or sample-app code, they carry distinct names (`PauseWXYC` in `Shared/Intents/Sources/Intents/PauseWXYC.swift` vs. `WhatsPlayingOnWXYC` in `WXYC/iOS/Intents.swift`) that encode different Siri/Shortcuts intent semantics — pausing playback versus querying what is currently playing. The structural similarity (both are empty-field type aliases wrapping intent objects) is a consequence of the SiriKit/AppIntents code pattern, not a sign of accidental duplication. Merging or extracting them would conflate two distinct user-facing intent actions and break the intent-dispatch contract in the `app:iOS` package.
